sections.text: Collect the vendor security questionnaire before signature.
Grant production access on day one so the vendor can self-serve.
Store completed questionnaires in the shared drive.

clauses.rule: evidence retained in the GRC system, not shared drives

inputs.goal: the vendor onboarding runbook, against InfoSec policy v4

summary.finding: The runbook instructs to grant production access on day one, which violates the 'least privilege' principle outlined in IS-3.1.
The runbook directs storing completed questionnaires in a shared drive instead of the GRC system, conflicting with IS-7.5 which mandates evidence retention in the GRC system.
